claim: Claude Code becomes more valuable when it can reason across multiple files and tools.

evidence.speaker: Annatar
evidence.quote: Cloud Code 的能力非常非常非常强大。

boundary: This only holds when the engineer can keep the task scoped and provide enough repository context.

claim: API-priced coding agents are too expensive for sustained heavy use.

evidence.speaker: Annatar
evidence.quote: 我一周可以花到 150 美金左右。

boundary: This matters when usage is frequent enough that token spend compounds week over week.
action: Prefer subscription-style plans for repeated use.
